title: Skill rule registry row
description: One versioned rule in the fusha sarf/nahw rule registry. Existing baseline rules are @1; the 2026-07-12 evolved (v-next) rules are @2; the 2026-07-12 calibration-cycle increment rules are @2.1 (candidate-only, drafted forward, never amending released @2). Validated fail-closed by tools/validate_skill_registry.py.

skill_rule_id.description: Stable unique id. Existing rules keep their SKILL-PARITY-MATRIX id; v-next keep their revised-rules rule_id.

skill_version.description: Must agree with `skill`: existing baseline = @1, evolved v-next = @2, calibration-cycle increment = @2.1 (candidate-only).

evidence_addresses.description: Source-addressed evidence anchors (SKILL.md loci, quran:S:A:W, impl-record paths). MUST be non-empty when status == accepted (fail-closed).

positive_examples.description: example_id references into the 142-row example bank (examples.jsonl + examples-fill.jsonl).

target_kind.description: registry = target_id is another skill_rule_id in this file (dangling-checked). external = an un-extracted SKILL.md passage (NOT-IN-MATRIX), exempt from the dangling check.

provenance.description: Free-form origin metadata (origin, source path, matrix_commit, relationship, coverage_verdict...).

projector.description: OPTIONAL lattice/projector sketch. Present on @2.1 (and later) rules that a deterministic transclusion/projection engine can key on. Makes a rule latticeable rather than prose-only.

readiness.description: projector_ready = the condition is machine-checkable and the projection deploys deterministically (a guard/routing/consistency projector). review_gated = the linguistic identification needs an authoring/2-vote pass; only the consequence is deterministic once identified.

condition.description: Machine-checkable trigger (what a projector matches on).

projection.description: The fact that propagates when the condition holds (or the abstention/hold that is forced).

guards.description: Homograph / 2-vote / qirāʾa / provenance guards that must be honored before the projection deploys.

scope.description: The keying scope of the projection.

allOf.description: Allowed (skill_version, status) transitions. @1 baseline may be accepted or candidate; @2 v-next and @2.1 increment may only be candidate or blocked (never released to accepted from this file).
